title: ""
page-layout: full

  text: |
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <style>
      .page-hero { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFF7ED 0%,#F8FAFC 60%); padding:3.5rem 2rem 3rem; }
      .page-hero-inner { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; }
      .page-hero h1 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.03em; margin-bottom:0.5rem; }
      .page-hero p { color:#64748B; font-size:0.96rem; }
      .stats-strip { max-width:900px; margin:2rem auto 0; padding:0 2rem; display:flex; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .sstat { background:#fff; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:14px; padding:1rem 1.5rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.8rem; flex:1; min-width:120px; transition:all 0.25s; }
      .sstat:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(99,102,241,0.1); }
      .sstat-icon { width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:10px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.9rem; flex-shrink:0; }
      .sstat-num { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.4rem; font-weight:800; color:#0D1117; line-height:1; }
      .sstat-lbl { font-size:0.72rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; }
      .filter-row { max-width:900px; margin:1.5rem auto 0; padding:0 2rem; display:flex; gap:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .chip { padding:6px 16px; border-radius:999px; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; background:#fff; color:#64748B; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif; transition:all 0.2s; }
      .chip:hover { border-color:#6366F1; color:#6366F1; }
      .chip.active { background:#6366F1; color:#fff; border-color:#6366F1; }
      .pw { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 2rem; }
      .sec-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.8rem; margin:2.5rem 0 1.2rem; }
      .sec-head h2 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; margin:0; }
      .sec-head-icon { width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:10px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.9rem; flex-shrink:0; }
      .pub-card { background:#fff; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:16px; padding:1.4rem 1.6rem; margin-bottom:1rem; transition:all 0.3s; }
      .pub-card:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(99,102,241,0.1); transform:translateY(-2px); }
      .pub-card.hidden { display:none; }
      .apa { font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.7; padding-left:1.5rem; text-indent:-1.5rem; font-weight:400; color:#334155; margin-bottom:1rem; }
      .apa em { font-style:italic; }
      .apa a { color:#6366F1; text-decoration:none; word-break:break-all; }
      .apa a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
      .abs-toggle { background:none; border:none; color:#6366F1; font-size:0.8rem; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; padding:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.3rem; margin-bottom:0.5rem; transition:opacity 0.2s; }
      .abs-toggle i { font-size:0.7rem; transition:transform 0.25s; }
      .abs-toggle.open i { transform:rotate(180deg); }
      .abs-toggle:hover { opacity:0.7; }
      .abs-body { display:none; font-size:0.86rem; color:#64748B; line-height:1.7; border-left:3px solid #6366F1; padding:0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1rem; margin-bottom:0.8rem; background:#EEF2FF; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; }
      .abs-body.open { display:block; }
      .pub-badges { display:flex; gap:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:0.8rem; }
      .pbadge { font-size:0.72rem; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:999px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.3rem; transition:opacity 0.2s; }
      .pbadge:hover { opacity:0.75; }
      .pb-doi { background:#EEF2FF; color:#6366F1; }
      .pb-pdf { background:#FFF7ED; color:#F97316; }
      .pb-code { background:#F1F5F9; color:#475569; }
      .pb-oa { background:#DCFCE7; color:#16A34A; }
    </style>

<script>
  function toggleAbs(btn) {
    const body = btn.nextElementSibling;
    body.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.innerHTML = body.classList.contains('open')
      ? '<i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i> Ẩn abstract'
      : '<i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i> Xem abstract';
  }
  function filterPub(btn, type) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.pub-card').forEach(c => {
      c.classList.toggle('hidden', type !== 'all' && c.dataset.type !== type);
    });
    ['journal','chapter','book'].forEach(s => {
      const h = document.querySelector(`.sec-head[data-section="${s}"]`);
      if (h) h.style.display = (type === 'all' || type === s) ? 'flex' : 'none';
    });
  }
</script>
